name: please-make-no-mistakes
description: Epistemic integrity for AI-assisted software engineering.

interface.longDescription: Investigates before changing a project, makes the evidence and uncertainty visible, keeps task knowledge in a user-controlled PMNM folder, asks for agreement on one plan Digest, verifies the result, and audits the complete change before the human commits.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this regression and show me the plan Digest before changing anything.
Review this change, verify its contract, and audit the full diff before I commit.
Resume this task from its PMNM folder and tell me what remains uncertain.
